    ],
)
def test_run_length_encode_happy_path(input_str, expected):

# -------------
# Edge cases
# -------------
def test_run_length_encode_empty_string():
    assert run_length_encode("") == []


def test_run_length_encode_single_char():
    assert run_length_encode("z") == [("z", 1)]


def test_run_length_encode_two_identical_chars():
    assert run_length_encode("11") == [("1", 2)]
